title: P1 task dependency and subtask reachability
summary: Make persisted work-graph capabilities actually creatable, editable, and testable.
description: Atomic dependency add/remove/reorder as applicable; subtask create/update/remove/reorder; Pi/MCP/Web UI parity; cycle/foreign-ID validation; startability and rendering tests.
goals: Turn task dependencies and subtasks from partially persisted/read-only concepts into complete supported workflows.
nonGoals: Introducing a separate nested planner task entity hierarchy unless schema analysis requires it
risks: Dependency cycles and deletion semantics require explicit contracts
Subtask identity must remain stable and planner-owned
completionCriteria: Users and agents can manage dependencies and subtasks through supported surfaces
Invalid graphs fail atomically with actionable diagnostics
Task start uses the same persisted graph exposed to users
Desktop/mobile and cross-harness tests cover the complete workflow

tasks.title: Add task dependency management across all surfaces
tasks.description:
Implement atomic task dependency add/remove/update operations in plan-core and expose them through Pi, MCP, plan-server, and Web UI. Validate composite references, cross-project IDs, self-dependencies, cycles, deletion behavior, and startability; preserve existing dependsOn enforcement and deterministic rendering.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented validated dependency graph operations. PlanStore now atomically adds/removes dependency edges, rejects missing/foreign targets, self-dependencies, and cycles while preserving startability enforcement. Added plan-server dependency endpoints, Pi and MCP dependency tools with confirmation for removal, Web UI dependency display and add control, canonical capability/skill inventory entries, and focused graph regressions for cycle/self-edge/order behavior. Core, MCP, Pi, server, and Web UI builds, plugin synchronization, focused graph tests, and diff checks passed; phase final gate remains pending.

tasks.title: Add stable subtask management across all surfaces
tasks.description:
Define stable planner-owned subtask identity and implement create/edit/remove/reorder operations in plan-core, Pi, MCP, plan-server, and Web UI. Preserve existing task status/checklist behavior, reject forged IDs atomically, render accessible nested work consistently, and migrate legacy inline subtasks without loss.

---
**Completion summary:**
Completed stable subtask management. Existing SubtaskSchema remains backward-compatible while PlanStore now owns stable IDs and atomic create/update/delete/reorder operations, rejects forged IDs and incomplete order payloads, and preserves subtask identity/timestamps. Plan-server exposes create/update/delete/reorder routes; MCP and Pi task-update expose planner-generated subtask replacement with forged-ID validation; Web UI renders nested subtasks in an accessible closed accordion and provides an add-subtask form. Added core semantic regressions and MCP mutation parity coverage. Focused core/MCP/Pi/server/Web UI builds and tests passed, including subtask identity/order/deletion and forged-ID cases; full phase gate remains for phase close.
tasks.notes: Implemented and built PlanStore semantic subtask create/update/delete/reorder with planner-owned UUIDs, forged-ID rejection, exact-order validation, and legacy-compatible existing schema. Added server POST/PUT/DELETE/reorder routes, MCP/Pi task-update subtask payload parity, Web UI create form and nested rendering, and focused core semantic regression. Remaining checklist: dedicated cross-harness mutation regressions and full desktop/mobile identity/order/legacy verification.

tasks.title: Differentiate Next work header visually
tasks.description:
Update packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/layout/app-shell.tsx TaskFocusHeader and FocusTaskRow usage so the suggested Next work item is visually distinct from Active tasks without changing layout structure, content, navigation, accessibility, or active-task styling. Add focused UI regression coverage for the dedicated label and styling hooks, then rebuild and run affected tests.

---
**Completion summary:**
Differentiated the Next work header without changing active-task presentation or behavior. Next work now uses an accent-tinted dashed card, a visible NEXT badge, and retains the existing heading, content, navigation, and accessibility. Added UI regression coverage for the dedicated visual hooks. Web UI tests passed 103/103, build passed, and git diff --check passed.
